newsitem.title: UK: Land at new high after fund manager report.
newsitem.headline: Land at new high after fund manager report.

text.p: Shares in Land Securities Plc hit a new high on Monday, boosted by continued institutional demand and a Merrill Lynch survey which showed fund managers were favouring property shares, dealers said.
By 0942 GMT, British Land shares were 15p firmer at 778, after setting a new peak of 780. Volume was 386,028 shares.
A monthly Merrill Lynch survey of fund managers' investment intentions showed a strong majority planned to increase their holdings of property stocks.
"The Merrill Lynch survey was covered in the Telegraph (newspaper) and that created some interest," one market-maker said.

"It's all one-way traffic in these property stocks," another market-maker said. "There's been some demand this morning from a couple of houses and it's looking a bit squeezy. It doesn't take a lot of buying to push these stocks higher."
